game.title: Tales of Arise
game.blurb: Action RPG from Bandai Namco Entertainment, released 2021-09-10. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Alphen and Shionne's journey to free Dahna and the realms beyond.

chapters.title: Sub-quests and Hobbies
chapters.summary: Sub-quests, fishing, cooking, the ranch, owls, artifacts and skits.

chapters.title: Crafting and Titles
chapters.summary: Forging weapons, crafting accessories, titles and spending gald.

chapters.title: Combat and Training
chapters.summary: Combos, big hits, Counter Edges, levels, gigants and the training grounds.

chapters.title: Beyond the Dawn
chapters.summary: The additional story expansion set after the main game.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 740130)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Tales_of_Arise
Fandom (aselia.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/Tales_of_Arise
notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough is linked but not written, and only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist. aselia.fandom.com (the Tales series wiki) answers the API, with about 292 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Onix" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 740130. 29 of 58 Steam achievements are hidden. 7 hidden ones are sorted by name into Beyond the Dawn because their unlock rates (2 to 4 percent) match the visible additional-story achievements; this is a guess and needs checking. The rest sit in the main story chapter.
